answer: A bond is refunded only after 47 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The inlet counter is kept in plume and fable makes public each reset. Anyone hence has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 47 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3021 identities would post 3076 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
